package day2;

public class Program_SpyNum {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
int num=1124; int check=num; int rem; int sum=0; int prod=1;
while (check>0)
{
	rem=check%10;
	sum=sum+rem;
	prod=prod*rem;
	check=check/10;
}
if (sum==prod)
	System.out.println(num+" is a Spy Number");
else
	System.out.println(num+" is not a Spy Number");
	}
}
